chunks: The Hour will certainly come; there is no doubt about it; but most people do not believe.
ai.seo_question: Why do most people not believe in the Hour despite its certainty?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ghafir, this verse underscores the inevitability of the Hour as a fundamental tenet of faith, contrasting divine certainty with human skepticism. Shia scholarship often highlights this as a reminder that disbelief stems not from lack of evidence, but from willful rejection, reinforcing the concept of *Tawhid* in its eschatological dimension. It serves as a spiritual call to align one's inner conviction with the external reality of resurrection.
